mechanism_narrative: A higher level of non-farm payrolls (PAYEMS) indicates sustained labor market strength, supporting consumer spending and corporate earnings growth, which drives positive S&P 500 forward returns over the next 20 trading days.
failure_condition: Rank IC between PAYEMS and 20-day SPX returns is below 0.03 over any 3-year rolling window.

mechanism_narrative: A sustained unemployment rate above 5.0% signals deteriorating labor market conditions, reducing consumer confidence and corporate profit expectations, leading to negative S&P 500 forward returns over the next 5 trading days.
failure_condition: SPX produces positive 5-day returns in more than 60% of instances where UNRATE > 5.0%.

mechanism_narrative: Joint deterioration in unemployment (UNRATE) and industrial production (INDPRO) signals a synchronized labor market and supply-side contraction, triggering recessionary fears that depress equity valuations and produce negative S&P 500 returns over 60 trading days.
failure_condition: SPX produces positive 60-day returns in more than 60% of instances where UNRATE rises and INDPRO falls.

mechanism_narrative: A monetary tightening cycle (FEDFUNDS > 4.5%) signals reduced liquidity and higher discount rates, compressing equity valuations and causing negative S&P 500 forward returns over the next 20 trading days.
failure_condition: SPX produces positive 20-day returns in more than 60% of instances where FEDFUNDS > 4.5%.

mechanism_narrative: A higher level of industrial production (INDPRO) indicates robust manufacturing activity, supporting economic growth and corporate earnings, which drives positive S&P 500 forward returns over the next 5 trading days.
failure_condition: Rank IC between INDPRO and 5-day SPX returns is below 0.03 over any 3-year rolling window.

mechanism_narrative: Housing starts below 1000 thousand units signal a collapsing housing market, reducing household wealth and consumer spending, leading to negative S&P 500 forward returns over the next 20 trading days.
failure_condition: SPX produces negative 20-day returns in less than 60% of instances where HOUST < 1000.

mechanism_narrative: Joint decline in non-farm payrolls (PAYEMS) and rising unemployment (UNRATE) signals accelerating labor market deterioration, reducing consumer spending and corporate revenue growth, causing negative S&P 500 returns over 60 trading days.
failure_condition: SPX produces positive 60-day returns in more than 60% of instances where PAYEMS falls and UNRATE rises.

mechanism_narrative: Strong housing starts above 1050 thousand units signal late-cycle economic overheating, increasing recession risk and triggering profit-taking that depresses S&P 500 returns over the next 5 trading days.
failure_condition: SPX produces negative 5-day returns in less than 60% of instances where HOUST > 1050.
